properties.description: James Allen is a prominent jewelry retailer known for revolutionizing the engagement ring buying process through high-definition 360-degree digital inspection technology. Founded in 2006, the brand offers a vast selection of loose diamonds, engagement settings, and fine jewelry with a focus on transparency and education. By providing non-commissioned gemologist consultations and accessible pricing, it serves as a modern alternative to traditional brick-and-mortar jewelers. The company is part of the Signet Jewelers portfolio and maintains both a robust online presence and select physical showroom locations.
